description: What an Excel run of the VBA harness must leave as evidence, read by tools/check_excel_run.py from the commit it checks, and by tools/render_docs.py. suite is the example suite, which certifies the harness itself in three modes; suites lists the project's own suites, each certified in its normal run by its own entry point. tests/test_check_excel_run.py keeps it equal to the example suite, its certification entry point and the host policy of INSTALLATION.md.
